project.title: airborne eDNA samples filtered in and outside bat roosts in Belize
project.description: This contains the raw data associated with our submission for the paper "Out of thin air: surveying tropical bat roosts through air sampling of eDNA". These raw data files contain data for two projects. Contact authors if you wish to reprocess the raw data so we can help you separate the two projects. eclare@yorku.ca
